youtube.aciklama: Caloric testing probes the VOR at a very low frequency of about 0.003 hertz, while vHIT tests high frequencies of roughly three to five hertz, so results can differ; a meta-analysis reported reduced caloric responses with normal vHIT in about half of Meniere's patients. If both tests were done correctly, both are right; the dissociation does not diagnose, but with the history it is a valuable clue.
